newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua inflation rises 1.19 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua inflation rises 1.19 percent in November.

text.p: Nicaraguan prices rose by 1.19 percent in November, bringing 1996's accumulated inflation to 10.06 percent, Nicaragua's Central Bank reported on Monday.
This pace was lower than in over the same period in 1995, when accumulated inflation was 12.09 percent.
Inflation over the past 12 months totaled 9.19 percent.
The Nicaraguan government has projected total inflation in 1996 to be less than 10 percent. December's inflation was negative in 1995.
The monthly cost of basic goods -- food, clothing and household products for a family of six -- rose by 2.13 ($0.24) in November for a total of 1,294.81 cordobas ($145.48).
State workers such as teachers and nurses earn about $60 per month.
